## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant checks and observed results. Note any checks not run and why.

## Compatibility

Describe environment, database migration, gameplay or deployment effects and the
rollback plan when applicable. Existing databases must not use fresh initialization
as an upgrade.

- [ ] No credentials, private environment files, database dumps or player data included.
- [ ] Asset provenance/notices included for new non-code material, or no assets changed.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior is tested; known limitations are documented.
- [ ] Original contributed code can be submitted under the project's MIT license.
